summary: Iter52b frontend-only smoke — Bug 28 (AITab no auto-scroll to bottom), Bug 29 (PlateBlurDialog simplified), CreateListing refactor with BulkPhotoUploader + ListingFormRentalCar/Garage subcomponents. All 4 items PASS.

Skip → grid + remove-0 works. Uploading 11 files caps grid at 10 items (toast expected, cap confirmed via remove-N count = 10). Old listing-photo-remove-N NOT present.
